scope: All48 graded exercise records in Modules8–11; each subclaim coverage distinguished. Some general algebra theorem families also cover legacy examples.

items.label: Exercise 8.P1 — Easy: Discounted reward and cost
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 8.P2 — Easy: A mixed action and its occupancy
items.limits: Normalized occupancies follow from a stationary self-loop model; full stochastic process is not encoded.

items.label: Exercise 8.P3 — Easy: Evaluate the penalized reward
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 8.P4 — Easy: Two projected multiplier updates
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 8.P5 — Medium: Verify discounted flow on two states
items.limits: Flow equations solved universally; connection between temporal state probabilities and occupancy uses the geometric-series theorem but full Markov law is not encoded.

items.label: Exercise 8.P6 — Medium: Solve a small constrained policy problem
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 8.P7 — Medium: A tail statistic differs from its expectation
items.limits: Expectation, global variational CVaR minimum, and smallest-CDF-crossing VaR for the explicit two-atom distribution are proved. Identification with a probability-space random variable is not separately encoded.

items.label: Exercise 8.P8 — Medium: Track a discounted remaining budget
items.limits: Two-step arithmetic and general all-time discounted-budget telescoping identity proved, assuming the stated recurrence.

items.label: Exercise 8.P9 — Hard: Recover the mixed optimum from the dual
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 8.P10 — Hard: Audit an average-violation guarantee
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 8.P11 — Hard: An expected budget can allow rare failure
items.limits: Expected cost, CVaR global minimum, and VaR smallest-CDF crossing proved for explicit two-atom law; no measure-space random variable construction.

items.label: Exercise 8.P12 — Hard: Derive the multiplier sign rather than memorizing it
items.limits: Pointwise weak duality and subgradient inequality from exact inner maximizer; complete policy supremum existence/attainment not encoded.

items.label: Exercise 9.P1 — Easy: Center an advantage under the old policy
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 9.P2 — Easy: Measure a change in action probabilities
items.limits: Total variation exact; numerical KL logarithm approximation is numerical only.

items.label: Exercise 9.P3 — Easy: Read the axes of a trust-region ellipse
items.limits: Quadratic-region equivalence; full axis endpoints follow by arithmetic but not a matrix spectral theorem.

items.label: Exercise 9.P4 — Easy: Check a linearized cost constraint
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 9.P5 — Medium: Solve the unconstrained trust-region step
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 9.P6 — Medium: Project a proposed step onto a cost half-space
items.limits: Universal projection objective lower bound; numerical optimizer and attainment checked separately.

items.label: Exercise 9.P7 — Medium: See how discounting enlarges a bound
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 9.P8 — Medium: Apply a pessimistic model cost check
items.limits: Successful bound propagation proved; failure to certify and confidence interpretation remain logical exposition.

items.label: Exercise 9.P9 — Hard: Solve a cost-constrained step on a disk
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 9.P10 — Hard: Audit a linearized boundary step
items.limits: Root identity and rejected linear boundary exact; positive-root selection/decimal approximation not formalized.

items.label: Exercise 9.P11 — Hard: Check support before importance weighting
items.limits: Importance weights arithmetic only; the all-policy support identity/counterexample are not encoded.

items.label: Exercise 9.P12 — Hard: Combine reward and cost confidence statements
items.limits: Actual measure union bound and exact scalar margins; source confidence/estimation events are assumptions.

items.label: Exercise 10.P1 — Easy: Read a barrier-defined safe set
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 10.P2 — Easy: Turn a barrier rate into an input bound
items.limits: Input inequality equivalence; differential Lie-derivative identification at h(x)=x is not encoded.

items.label: Exercise 10.P3 — Easy: Repair a scalar nominal input
items.limits: Universal objective lower bound, feasible optimizer, correction, attained value and uniqueness. CBF interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 10.P4 — Easy: Check an inward-pointing vector field
items.limits: All-time explicit trajectory stays in interval; differential equation solution identity and general Nagumo theorem not encoded.

items.label: Exercise 10.P5 — Medium: Project onto a two-input half-space
items.limits: Universal objective lower bound, unique optimizer, attained value and explicit feasibility/stationarity/dual-feasibility/complementarity equations at multiplier 1/2. The general KKT theorem is not needed for this direct proof.

items.label: Exercise 10.P6 — Medium: Check feasibility with actuator limits
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 10.P7 — Medium: Include the worst-case disturbance
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 10.P8 — Medium: Compute a high-order barrier condition
items.limits: Numerical auxiliary-set arithmetic; differential identities and general high-order CBF theorem not formalized.

items.label: Exercise 10.P9 — Hard: Audit a zero-gradient boundary test
items.limits: Counterexample trajectory sign and zero gradient arithmetic; derivative identity and ODE solution are prose.

items.label: Exercise 10.P10 — Hard: Compare continuous feedback with a held input
items.limits: Every holding interval characterized and exponential positivity proved; ODE solution identification not formalized.

items.label: Exercise 10.P11 — Hard: Shift a feasible predictive backup plan
items.limits: Exact plan successors and universal terminal input/state certificate; general MPC shift theorem not formalized.

items.label: Exercise 10.P12 — Hard: Compute a shield and change the disturbance quantifier
items.limits: Original finite shield and adverse failing successor checked. Full infinite-horizon game fixed-point not encoded.

items.label: Exercise 11.P1 — Easy: Compute decrease and a sublevel set
items.limits: Universal strict decrease and sublevel identity; image endpoint arithmetic is not a separate theorem.

items.label: Exercise 11.P2 — Easy: Read a quadratic certificate geometrically
items.limits: Exact sample values; axis geometry shares9P3 quadratic-form arguments.

items.label: Exercise 11.P3 — Easy: Check uncertain decrease at one point
items.limits: Universal disturbance decrease at the stated point. Origin counterexample not separately encoded.

items.label: Exercise 11.P4 — Easy: Check a local expected-budget inequality
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 11.P5 — Medium: Carry a sample certificate between grid points
items.limits: All-point bound propagation from stated sampled/error/distance assumptions; general Lipschitz transfer proved in CoreAnalysis.

items.label: Exercise 11.P6 — Medium: Build an invariant error tube and tighten constraints
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 11.P7 — Medium: Solve a one-step MPC objective with an input limit
items.limits: Global constrained optimum lower bound and attainment; unconstrained optimizer derivative not separately encoded.

items.label: Exercise 11.P8 — Medium: Interpret zero failures through Hoeffding
items.limits: Proves the real logarithmic Hoeffding radius is strictly above the1% target. The probabilistic concentration theorem and0.038702 decimal remain separately numerical/reviewed.

items.label: Exercise 11.P9 — Hard: Find the strict-decrease region of a nonlinear loop
items.limits: Exact polynomial identity, strictness in x²<2, invariance, full sequence convergence and explicit two-cycle proved. Necessity for every c≥2 not separately encoded.

items.label: Exercise 11.P10 — Hard: Distinguish relative and absolute policy approximation errors
items.limits: Proof covers the displayed numerical/algebraic mathematical conclusion. Explanatory application interpretation is reviewed separately.

items.label: Exercise 11.P11 — Hard: Choose a validation sample size and account for selection
items.limits: Exact rational powers and full all-natural-number minimality iff n≥299/597 proved. IID Bernoulli zero-failure probability formula is assumed in interpretation.

items.label: Exercise 11.P12 — Hard: Compose statistical coverage with a robust certificate
items.limits: Actual measure union bound and budget arithmetic; source robust safety implication itself is an assumption.

claims_not_made: No claim that all advanced research theorems or entire stochastic MDP semantics are formally verified.
Imported Mathlib proofs are standard trusted dependency artifacts unless explicitly rechecked.

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.discounted_constant
declarations.statement:
theorem discounted_constant (c γ : ℝ) (hγ : |γ| < 1) :
    (∑' t : ℕ, γ ^ t * c) = c / (1 - γ)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.cmdp_p5_flow
declarations.statement:
theorem cmdp_p5_flow (r₀ r₁ : ℝ)
    (h₀ : r₀ = 1/2) (h₁ : r₁ = (r₀+r₁)/2) :
    r₀ = 1/2 ∧ r₁ = 1/2 ∧ (0*r₀+2*r₁)/(1-1/2) = 2

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.cmdp_p6_feasible
declarations.statement:
theorem cmdp_p6_feasible (p : ℝ) :
    (0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 1 ∧ 4*p ≤ 1) ↔ (0 ≤ p ∧ p ≤ 1/4)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.cmdp_p7_cvar
declarations.statement:
theorem cmdp_p7_cvar : tailObjective (1/5) 10 (9/10) 10 = 10 ∧
    ∀ ν : ℝ, 10 ≤ tailObjective (1/5) 10 (9/10) ν

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.cmdp_p7_var
declarations.statement:
theorem cmdp_p7_var : (1/5 : ℝ)*10 = 2 ∧
    9/10 ≤ binaryCDF (1/5) 10 10 ∧
    ∀ z : ℝ, z < 10 → binaryCDF (1/5) 10 z < 9/10

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.cmdp_p11_var
declarations.statement:
theorem cmdp_p11_var : 19/20 ≤ binaryCDF (1/100) 100 0 ∧
    ∀ z : ℝ, z < 0 → binaryCDF (1/100) 100 z < 19/20

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.cmdp_p9_upper
declarations.statement:
theorem cmdp_p9_upper (p l : ℝ) (h₀ : 0 ≤ p) (h₁ : p ≤ 1) :
    2+6*p-l*(4*p-1) ≤ dual8 l

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.cmdp_p11_cvar
declarations.statement:
theorem cmdp_p11_cvar : (1/100 : ℝ)*100 = 1 ∧
    tailObjective (1/100) 100 (19/20) 0 = 20 ∧
    ∀ ν : ℝ, 20 ≤ tailObjective (1/100) 100 (19/20) ν

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.weak_duality_max
declarations.statement:
theorem weak_duality_max (reward cost budget l bound : ℝ)
    (hl : 0 ≤ l) (hcost : cost ≤ budget)
    (hbound : reward-l*(cost-budget) ≤ bound) : reward ≤ bound

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.dual_subgradient
declarations.statement:
theorem dual_subgradient (reward cost budget l l' D D' : ℝ)
    (hmax : D = reward-l*(cost-budget))
    (hbound : reward-l'*(cost-budget) ≤ D') :
    D + (l'-l)*(budget-cost) ≤ D'

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.cmdp_legacy_two_state
declarations.statement:
theorem cmdp_legacy_two_state (p₁ p₂ : ℝ) (h₂ : 0 ≤ p₂)
    (hbudget : p₁+p₂ ≤ 9/10) : (4/3)*p₁+(2/3)*p₂ ≤ 6/5

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.cmdp_legacy_two_state_unique
declarations.statement:
theorem cmdp_legacy_two_state_unique (p₁ p₂ : ℝ) (h₂ : 0 ≤ p₂)
    (hbudget : p₁+p₂ ≤ 9/10) (hopt : (4/3)*p₁+(2/3)*p₂ = 6/5) :
    p₁ = 9/10 ∧ p₂ = 0

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.cmdp_legacy_cvar
declarations.statement: theorem cmdp_legacy_cvar : legacyTail 10 = 46 ∧ ∀ ν : ℝ, 46 ≤ legacyTail ν

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.policy_p5_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem policy_p5_bound (x y : ℝ) (h : x^2+4*y^2 ≤ 1) :
    x+2*y ≤ Real.sqrt 2

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.policy_p9_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem policy_p9_bound (x y : ℝ) (hd : x^2+y^2 ≤ 1) (hx : x ≤ 1/5) :
    x+y ≤ 1/5+Real.sqrt (24/25)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.barrier_p2
declarations.statement: theorem barrier_p2 (x u : ℝ) : 0 ≤ u+2*x ↔ -2*x ≤ u

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.barrier_p4_interval
declarations.statement:
theorem barrier_p4_interval (x t : ℝ) (hx : 0 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2) (ht : 0 ≤ t) :
    0 ≤ 1+(x-1)*Real.exp (-t) ∧ 1+(x-1)*Real.exp (-t) ≤ 2

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.barrier_p5_unique
declarations.statement:
theorem barrier_p5_unique (u v : ℝ) (h : 1 ≤ u+v)
    (he : (1/2)*(u^2+v^2) = 1/4) : u = 1/2 ∧ v = 1/2

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.barrier_p7_robust
declarations.statement:
theorem barrier_p7_robust (u x : ℝ) :
    (∀ w : ℝ, |w| ≤ 3/10 → 0 ≤ u+w+x) ↔ 3/10-x ≤ u

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.barrier_p10_held_interval
declarations.statement:
theorem barrier_p10_held_interval (Δ : ℝ) (hΔ : 0 ≤ Δ) :
    (∀ t : ℝ, 0 ≤ t → t ≤ Δ → 0 ≤ 1-t) ↔ Δ ≤ 1

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.barrier_p10_continuous
declarations.statement:
theorem barrier_p10_continuous (t : ℝ) : 0 < Real.exp (-t) := Real.exp_pos _

theorem barrier_p11_plan : (1 : ℝ)-1/2 = 1/2 ∧
    (1/2 : ℝ)-1/4 = 1/4 ∧ (1/4 : ℝ)-1/4 = 0

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.barrier_p12_shield
declarations.statement:
theorem barrier_p12_shield :
    safe (successor .a .left) ∧ ¬ safe (successor .a .right) ∧
    safe (successor .b .left) ∧ safe (successor .b .right) ∧
    ¬ (∀ s ∈ ({ShieldState.b, ShieldState.failure} : Finset ShieldState), safe s)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.lyapunov_p1_sublevel
declarations.statement: theorem lyapunov_p1_sublevel (x : ℝ) : x^2 ≤ 4 ↔ -2 ≤ x ∧ x ≤ 2

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreModules.lyapunov_p5_transfer
declarations.statement:
theorem lyapunov_p5_transfer (d dg error distance : ℝ)
    (hs : dg ≤ -3/25) (he : error ≤ 1/50) (hr : distance ≤ 1/100)
    (h : d ≤ dg+error+5*distance) : d ≤ -1/20

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.discounted_budget_telescopes
declarations.statement:
theorem discounted_budget_telescopes (z c : ℕ → ℝ) (γ budget : ℝ)
    (h₀ : z 0 = budget) (hstep : ∀ n, γ*z (n+1) = z n-c n) :
    ∀ n, budget-∑ t ∈ Finset.range n, γ^t*c t = γ^n*z n

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.geometric_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem geometric_bound (e : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq : 0 ≤ q)
    (hstep : ∀ n, e (n+1) ≤ q*e n) (n : ℕ) : e n ≤ q^n*e 0

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.geometric_convergence
declarations.statement:
theorem geometric_convergence (x : ℕ → ℝ) (q : ℝ) (hq₀ : 0 ≤ q) (hq₁ : q < 1)
    (hstep : ∀ n, |x (n+1)| ≤ q*|x n|) : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 0)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.relative_error_convergence
declarations.statement:
theorem relative_error_convergence (x e : ℕ → ℝ)
    (hstep : ∀ n, x (n+1) = (1/2)*x n+e n)
    (he : ∀ n, |e n| ≤ (1/10)*|x n|) : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 0)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.nonlinear_envelope
declarations.statement:
theorem nonlinear_envelope (x : ℕ → ℝ) (h₀ : (x 0)^2 ≤ 1)
    (hstep : ∀ n, x (n+1) = x n-(x n)^3) :
    ∀ n : ℕ, (x n)^2 ≤ 1/(n+1 : ℝ)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.nonlinear_convergence
declarations.statement:
theorem nonlinear_convergence (x : ℕ → ℝ) (h₀ : (x 0)^2 ≤ 1)
    (hstep : ∀ n, x (n+1) = x n-(x n)^3) : Tendsto x atTop (𝓝 0)

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.finite_union_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem finite_union_bound {Ω I : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω] [Fintype I]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (bad : I → Set Ω) (δ : I → ℝ≥0∞)
    (h : ∀ i, μ (bad i) ≤ δ i) : μ (⋃ i, bad i) ≤ ∑ i, δ i

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.compose_failure_bounds
declarations.statement:
theorem compose_failure_bounds {Ω : Type*} [MeasurableSpace Ω]
    (μ : Measure Ω) (bad E F : Set Ω) (α β : ℝ≥0∞)
    (hcover : bad ⊆ E ∪ F) (hE : μ E ≤ α) (hF : μ F ≤ β) :
    μ bad ≤ α+β

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.sampled_lower_certificate
declarations.statement:
theorem sampled_lower_certificate {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (f : X → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (x z : X)
    (m r : ℝ) (hz : m ≤ f z) (hr : dist x z ≤ r) :
    m-L*r ≤ f x

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.sampled_upper_certificate
declarations.statement:
theorem sampled_upper_certificate {X : Type*} [PseudoMetricSpace X]
    (f : X → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (hf : LipschitzWith L f) (x z : X)
    (m r : ℝ) (hz : f z ≤ m) (hr : dist x z ≤ r) :
    f x ≤ m+L*r

declarations.name: SafeLearning.CoreAnalysis.affine_error_bound
declarations.statement:
theorem affine_error_bound (e : ℕ → ℝ) (L a : ℝ) (hL : 0 ≤ L)
    (hzero : e 0 = 0) (hstep : ∀ n, e (n+1) ≤ L*e n+a) :
    ∀ n, e n ≤ a*∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, L^i
